E20FX.NeedsSequencer: Essence20 FX needs the Sequencer module: turn it on in Manage Modules.
E20FX.NoJB2A: Essence20 FX: no JB2A animation pack is active, so only sounds will play. Install "JB2A - Free Content" for the animations.

Enabled.Name: Play effects
Enabled.Hint: Animations and sounds for the whole table. Each player can still turn them off for themselves in Sequencer's settings.

Combat.Name: Attack effects
Combat.Hint: A projectile or swing, an impact, and a sound for every attack - in the look of its damage type - and a burst for area attacks.

Damage.Name: Damage, Defeat and healing effects
Damage.Hint: A token flashes and shakes when it takes damage, a Defeated one gets a puff of smoke and a skull, and a glow plays when Health comes back or Stun is recovered.

Conditions.Name: Condition effects
Conditions.Hint: A short icon and sound when a token gains a Condition: Stunned stars, Frightened, Poisoned, Prone, chains for Grappled...

Signature.Name: Morph, Transform and Zord effects
Signature.Hint: Morphing in the Ranger's own colour, Transforming, Energon, Zords arriving, boarding and being recalled, Megazords and Combiners forming and breaking apart.

Extras.Name: Story Point, Spellcasting and teamwork effects
Extras.Hint: Story Points spent, Spellcasting sparkles in the caster's colour, the Weird's static, help from a teammate (hearts in My Little Pony), rerolls (fireworks for ponies), and Requisitions arriving.

CombatStings.Name: Combat start, round and turn effects
CombatStings.Hint: "Combat!" across the screen when combat starts, the round number each new round, "Your turn" for the players whose character is up, and a bell when combat ends. With a Foundry Combat Theme picked, its sounds play instead of these.

Volume.Name: Effect volume
Volume.Hint: How loud the effect sounds play (each player's Interface volume applies on top).

ReducedMotion.Name: Reduced motion
ReducedMotion.Hint: Hear the effect sounds but don't see the animations. Just for you.

Ambient.Name: Lasting effects
Ambient.Hint: Effects that stay while a state lasts: a Morphed Ranger's aura, a Zord's dust, a Megazord's glow, Defeated smoke, and markers for Stunned, Poisoned, Frightened, Deafened and held.

AmbientActive.Name: Ring on the active combatant
AmbientActive.Hint: A ring under the token whose turn it is.

EmblemFlash.Name: Faction emblem flash
EmblemFlash.Hint: The emblem flashes up on a Morph, a Transform, and a Megazord or Combiner forming.

EmblemsOnDice.Name: Faction emblems on dice
EmblemsOnDice.Hint: With Dice So Nice: a d20 per faction whose 20 shows its emblem, in each player's Dice So Nice dice choices. Takes effect after a reload.

DiceAutoColour.Name: Dice in my character's colours
DiceAutoColour.Hint: With Dice So Nice: your character's rolls use their colours - a Ranger's, their faction's, or their line's. Just for you.

SceneAmbience.Name: Scene ambience
SceneAmbience.Hint: Play the loop each scene's Configuration picks (its Environment tab): Night Vale static, Energon motes, sparkles, fog, battlefield smoke, wind, fireflies.

EmblemOnCards.Name: Faction emblems on roll cards
EmblemOnCards.Hint: A character's faction emblem beside their name on their roll cards in chat.

AttackAnimator.Name: Attack animations by
AttackAnimator.Hint: Only with the Automated Animations module active. It has no Essence20 support of its own; this hands it each attack (who, with what, at whom, which hit). "When it has one" uses its animation for an item it's set up for - its own settings on the item (the item sheet's Automated Animations button), or a name its Automatic Recognition knows - and Essence20 FX's otherwise. Area attacks, and everything that isn't an attack, stay with Essence20 FX.
AttackAnimator.AaFirst: Automated Animations when it has one, else Essence20 FX

AutorecSounds.Name: Sounds on the Automated Animations entries
AutorecSounds.Hint: The Essence20 entries added to Automated Animations play this module's sounds (applies the next time they're added).

EmblemBadge.Name: Faction badges on tokens
EmblemBadge.Hint: Each token wears its faction's emblem as a small badge on its top-left corner (set the images in Faction Emblems).

EmblemTurnMarkers.Name: Faction turn markers
EmblemTurnMarkers.Hint: Each token's turn marker (the image under the token whose turn it is) becomes its faction's marker image, where one is set in Faction Emblems. A turn marker someone picked for a token by hand is left alone.

Config.Title: Configure FX
Config.Hint: Change or turn off the animation and sound of any effect, preview it, and export or import the lot.
Config.Intro: Change what any effect plays. Leave a field empty to keep the module's own (shown greyed). An animation is a Sequencer database path (jb2a....) or a file; a sound is a file, or "none" for silence. Preview plays it just for you, on the selected token (and the targeted one, for an attack).
Config.IntroActor: This character's own effects, played over the GM's. Leave a field empty to keep the table's. Preview plays it just for you.
Config.ColorHint: Used for Morphing and Spellcasting instead of the sheet colour - a hex colour like #ff2266. Empty uses the sheet's.
Config.Silent: No sound (click again for the default)
Config.Imported: Read {count} changed effects from the file - Save to keep them.
Config.ImportBad: That file isn't an Essence20 FX export.
Config.PreviewNeedsToken: Select a token to preview on.
Config.PreviewNeedsTarget: Target another token to preview an attack.
Config.FactionHint: Which of the GM's faction emblems this character wears. Automatic follows its Faction item, then its folder.

Moment.attack-area-critical: Area: Critical Success on a target

Emblems.Title: Faction Emblems
Emblems.Hint: Your own images for each faction: a badge on its tokens' corner, a flash on a Morph or Transform, its turn marker, roll cards, dice.
Emblems.Intro: The module ships no faction symbols - they belong to Hasbro - but you can use your own. Each faction can have an emblem and a turn marker. A character wears its Faction item's, else its folder's, else the one picked in its Effects window. "Import folder" fills the rows from a folder whose files are named for them: cobra.png for the emblem, cobra-marker.png for the turn marker. Tint colours the emblem (leave it empty to keep its own colours).
Emblems.Imported: Matched {count} images to factions ({unmatched} didn't match a name).
Emblems.EmblemSpec: A badge on the token's corner (a third of its width), the flash on a Morph or Transform, roll cards and dice. Square, {ideal} px, transparent background (PNG or WebP); at least {min} px. Keep it bold and simple - it shows small.
Emblems.MarkerSpec: Foundry's own marker under the token whose turn it is. Foundry draws it square at 1.5x the token, under the token - so only the outer ring shows - and spins it. Square, {ideal} x {ideal} px (Foundry's own are 512), transparent; {min} to {max} px. Put the design in the outer band - a ring, or the symbol repeated around it.
Emblems.BadgePreview: How the badge sits on a token
Emblems.MarkerPreview: How the turn marker shows: the grey disc is the token covering its middle

Advice.badgeNotSquare: not square - it keeps its shape, so it shows smaller, with a gap above and below or at the sides.
Advice.markerNotSquare: not square - Foundry stretches a turn marker to a square, so it will look squashed.
Advice.tooSmall: small - it may look blurry (use at least {min} px).
Advice.tooBig: bigger than it needs to be ({ideal} px is plenty).
Advice.opaque: a JPEG can't be transparent, so it shows as a box - use PNG or WebP.

SceneAmbience.Label: Essence20 FX ambience
SceneAmbience.Hint: A loop over the whole scene, for everyone (a player's Reduced motion keeps it off their screen). Needs JB2A.

Looks.nightvale: Night Vale: violet haze and static

Autorec.Title: Essence20 weapons for Automated Animations
Autorec.Hint: Adds Automatic Recognition entries for the words Essence20 weapon names use - Blaster, Laser, Rifle, Pistol, Cannon, Grenade, Launcher, Blade, Saber, Bludgeon, Claw and more - to Automated Animations' menus. Your own entries are never replaced. Needs Automated Animations.
Autorec.Confirm: Add Automatic Recognition entries for Essence20 weapons (Blaster, Laser, Rifle, Pistol, Cannon, Grenade, Launcher, Blade, Saber, Bludgeon, Claw and more) to Automated Animations? Only entries whose names its menus don't have yet are added; yours stay as they are. You can edit or delete them in its Automatic Recognition menu.
Autorec.Added: Added {count} Essence20 entries to Automated Animations.

E20FX.LegacySystem: Essence20 FX: this world runs Essence20 {version}. Attacks, damage, Defeat, Conditions, Morph, Transform, Energon, Megazords forming and Story Points play; area bursts, Zords arriving and leaving, Megazords breaking apart, Requisitions, rerolls and help from a teammate need Essence20 6.0.5.

Offer.Title: Essence20 FX
Offer.Content: Want a quick tour of the settings? It shows where to turn each kind of effect on or off, set the volume, and find Configure FX and Faction Emblems. You can run it again any time from Manage Tours in the Settings sidebar.

StartHere.Title: Essence20 FX: Start here
StartHere.Description: What plays and when, and where to turn each kind of effect on or off, set the volume and find the module's windows.

Intro.Title: Animations and sounds
Intro.Content:
Essence20 FX plays an animation and a sound when something happens in the rules: an attack hits or misses, a Ranger Morphs, a Zord arrives, a Story Point is spent.
It plays them for everyone at the table, through Sequencer. This tour shows where to set it up.

Settings.Title: Configure Settings
Settings.Content: Everything is set up from Configure Settings, in the Settings sidebar.

Category.Title: Essence20 FX settings
Category.Content: This module's page. Most of it is the GM's, for the whole table; a few settings at the bottom are each player's own.

Enabled.Title: Play effects
Enabled.Content: The switch for everything at once - turn it off for a scene that needs to stay quiet.

Kinds.Title: Each kind of effect
Kinds.Content:
Below it, a switch for each kind: attacks, damage, Defeat and healing, Conditions, Morph / Transform / Zords, Story Points, Spellcasting and teamwork, and combat's start, rounds and turns.
Turn off what your table finds too busy and keep the rest.

Lasting.Title: Lasting effects
Lasting.Content:
Effects that stay while a state lasts: a Morphed Ranger's aura, Defeated smoke, a marker over a Stunned or Poisoned token.
The ring on the active combatant is off unless you turn it on.

Emblems.Title: Faction emblems
Emblems.Content:
Where your faction emblems show: a badge on tokens, turn markers, a flash, roll cards and dice.
The module ships no emblems - you add your own images in Faction Emblems.

Animator.Title: Attack animations by
Animator.Content: Only matters with Automated Animations turned on: who animates attacks. The default uses Automated Animations when it has an animation for the item, and Essence20 FX's otherwise.

Volume.Title: Effect volume
Volume.Content: How loud the sounds are for everyone. Each player's own Interface volume applies on top.

ReducedMotion.Title: Reduced motion
ReducedMotion.Content: Each player's own: they hear the sounds but don't see the animations. Players can also turn effects or sounds off entirely in Sequencer's settings.

Menus.Title: The module's windows
Menus.Content: Configure FX changes what each effect plays. Faction Emblems takes your faction images. Add Essence20 weapons gives Automated Animations names it recognises, when you use it.

Outro.Title: Where to next
Outro.Content:
The Configure FX tour shows how to change or turn off one effect. Faction Emblems shows how to add your own emblems, and Scene ambience how to give a scene a loop of its own.
Your players can take "Effects for players" for their own settings. All of them are in Manage Tours.

ConfigureFx.Title: Essence20 FX: Configure FX
ConfigureFx.Description: Change what one effect plays - another animation or sound, its volume - or turn it off, preview it, and share your setup.

Intro.Title: Configure FX
Intro.Content:
Configure FX lists every effect the module plays, so you can change one without touching the rest.
This tour opens it. Nothing changes unless you press Save.

Button.Title: Open Configure FX
Button.Content: Configure FX is on this module's page in Configure Settings.

Groups.Title: Every effect
Groups.Content:
The effects are grouped by what sets them off: attacks, areas, damage, Conditions, Morph / Transform / Zords, and the rest.
A row you have changed is marked.

On.Title: On or off
On.Content: Untick an effect to stop it playing, without turning off the rest of its kind.

Animation.Title: Its animation
Animation.Content: Leave it blank for the default (shown greyed out). To change it, type a Sequencer database path such as jb2a.impact.004.blue, or browse for a video file with the clapperboard button.

Sound.Title: Its sound
Sound.Content: Blank for the default, or browse for a sound file with the music button. The speaker button mutes this one effect; click it again for the default sound.

Volume.Title: Its volume
Volume.Content: From 0 to 1, for this effect only. Blank uses the module's Effect volume.

Preview.Title: Preview
Preview.Content: Plays the effect as the row stands now, saved or not, on the token you have selected. Select a token on the map first.

Reset.Title: Reset
Reset.Content: Puts the row back to the default.

Share.Title: Export and Import
Share.Content: Export saves your changes to a JSON file; Import reads one in - press Save to keep it. A handy way to share a setup with another table.

Save.Title: Save
Save.Content: Save keeps your changes for the world. Close the window without saving and nothing changes.

Outro.Title: A character's own effects
Outro.Content:
Each character can have their own version of this list too - a Ranger's Morph in their own look - from the Effects item in their sheet's header menu. It plays over yours.
The "Effects for players" tour shows it.

FactionEmblems.Title: Essence20 FX: Faction Emblems
FactionEmblems.Description: Add your own faction images: the badge on a token's corner, the flash on a Morph or Transform, and the turn marker.

Intro.Title: Faction emblems
Intro.Content:
The module ships no faction symbols - they belong to Hasbro - but you can add your own images for each faction.
This tour opens Faction Emblems. Nothing changes unless you press Save.

Button.Title: Open Faction Emblems
Button.Content: Faction Emblems is on this module's page in Configure Settings.

Specs.Title: Two images each
Specs.Content: Each faction can have an emblem and a turn marker. This says what size and shape each should be.

Name.Title: The faction's name
Name.Content: A character wears the emblem of the Faction item it has, else of the folder it is in - so name the faction the way those are named. The tint colours the flash. The bin removes the faction.

Emblem.Title: The emblem
Emblem.Content:
The badge on the token's corner, the flash on a Morph, a Transform or a Megazord forming, and the mark beside the name on roll cards.
A square, transparent PNG or WebP, bold and simple - it shows small. The preview shows it on a token.

Marker.Title: The turn marker
Marker.Content:
Foundry's marker under the token whose turn it is. Foundry draws it larger than the token and under it, so only the outer ring shows.
A square, transparent image with the design in its outer band. A marker picked for a token by hand is never replaced.

Add.Title: Add a faction
Add.Content: For a faction not on the list.

Import.Title: Import folder
Import.Content: Pick a folder of images and they are matched to the factions by file name: cobra.png for the emblem, cobra-marker.png for the turn marker.

Save.Title: Save
Save.Content: Save keeps the images for the world. Which places they show is set by the Faction emblems settings on the module page.

Outro.Title: One character, another faction
Outro.Content: To give one character a different emblem - or none - open the Effects item in their sheet's header menu and pick it there.

SceneAmbience.Title: Essence20 FX: Scene ambience
SceneAmbience.Description: Give a scene a loop of its own - Night Vale haze, Energon motes, fog, battlefield smoke - played over the whole map.

Intro.Title: Scene ambience
Intro.Content:
A scene can have a loop that plays over the whole map while you're on it: Night Vale's violet haze and static, Energon motes, sparkles, fog, smoke, wind, fireflies.
This tour opens this scene's configuration. Nothing changes unless you save it.

Field.Title: The scene's ambience
Field.Content: Pick a look here and save the scene. Everyone viewing it sees the loop, except players with Reduced motion on.

Setting.Title: Turning it off
Setting.Content: This switch turns every scene's ambience off at once, without losing each scene's choice.

Outro.Title: That's it
Outro.Content: Each scene keeps its own choice, so set it once per scene.

MyEffects.Title: Essence20 FX: Effects for players
MyEffects.Description: Your own settings: Reduced motion, dice in your character's colours, and your character's own effects and emblem.

Intro.Title: Your own effects
Intro.Content: Animations and sounds play for everyone when something happens in the game. This tour shows the settings that are yours alone, and how to give your character their own look.

Settings.Title: Configure Settings
Settings.Content: Your settings are in Configure Settings, in the Settings sidebar.

ReducedMotion.Title: Reduced motion
ReducedMotion.Content:
On: you still hear the sounds, but don't see the animations. It only changes your screen.
To turn effects or sounds off completely, use Sequencer's settings.

Dice.Title: Dice in your character's colours
Dice.Content: With Dice So Nice: your dice in your Ranger's colour, else your faction's or your game line's. Dice So Nice's own settings also list the Essence20 colour sets.

Header.Title: Your character's Effects
Header.Content: In your character sheet's header menu, Effects opens your character's own effects.

Color.Title: Effect colour
Color.Content: The colour of your Morph and your Spellcasting. Blank uses your character's own colour.

Faction.Title: Faction emblem
Faction.Content: Which faction emblem your character wears, if your GM has added emblems. Worked out by itself from your Faction, unless you pick one.

Rows.Title: Your versions
Rows.Content: Any effect can be changed for your character alone - another animation or sound, or off - and plays over the GM's. Preview plays it on your selected token.

Save.Title: Save
Save.Content: Save keeps your choices on your character. Close without saving and nothing changes.

Outro.Title: That's it
Outro.Content: You can run this tour again any time from Manage Tours, in the Settings sidebar.
